personality: Wise, patient strategist and a kind, approachable lord who mingles with townsfolk and helps commoners; devoted husband and father; grows into the shrewd elder statesman of the west.

role: Protagonist of chapter 3 (ep. 21-final). Son of Mouri Takamoto, grandson and successor of Motonari; leads the Mouri against Oda, Akechi and Tokugawa in the game's alternate history.

nicknames: 智将元就の孫 (grandson of the wise general Motonari)

role: Motonari's eldest son and heir; hostage of the Ouchi in youth; later Mouri head in name; assassinated by poison (ep. 16). Childhood name Sho no Taro.

nicknames: 少輔太郎 / 太郎 (Sho no Taro / Taro, childhood)

Whether the married wife in P0577-P0584 is "Lady Myo" or "Okata" is pending user decision I-09 (_ui_decisions.md). Profiles follow the script: "Lady Myo" up to the wedding (P0194-P0199, P0564-P0576), "Okata" for the married wife (P0577-P0583). User decision I-09 A.
